_note: case-type-conditional-rules (openspec/changes/case-type-conditional-rules). A case type says, as configuration, what happens when a case meets a condition: 'Als Bouwkosten groter is dan 100.000, dan taak Toets door constructeur toevoegen'. Dossiq evaluates none of it: CaseTypeRuleProjector projects each rule at publish onto the engine that owns the action. A fragment per ADR-037. caseType 1.38.0: RENUMBER at merge if 1.35-1.37 are taken by then. case 1.51.0 `variant`: written by a chooseVariant rule (renumbered in b35b: 1.49.0 is DQ-REINT's, 1.50.0 case-type-rights-enforced's).

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: What happens when a case of this type meets a condition, in order. Each rule has a moment, conditions that must all hold and actions. Published with the version and frozen with it. The Rules tab lists them as 'Als ... / dan ...' rows.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable within the case type; part of the key that makes a rule's effect happen once per case.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the rule is called, when the sentence is not enough.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Whether the rule is projected at publish.

when.title: When
when.description: The moment: event created, saved or statusEntered (with status, a statusType uuid).

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: All must hold. kind fieldCompare {field, op: eq|neq|gt|gte|lt|lte, value}, fieldEquals {field, value}, fieldPresent {field}, documentPresent {documentType}, statusIs {status}. field names a case property or one of this type's property definitions.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: action addTask {title, taskType?}, setField {field, value}, chooseVariant {variant}, requireDocument {documentType}, sendMessage {emailTemplate}.

entryRequirements.title: Entry requirements
entryRequirements.description: Projected at publish from the rules, never edited by hand: per statusType uuid, the documents a case must carry before it enters that status ([{documentType, rule}]). Read by the statusEntryRequirements transition guard.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: The route this case takes through its case type, by the variant's name (caseType.variants). Written by a chooseVariant rule of the case type; empty means the default variant.
